feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Discursive Verses: Vic Mensa and the rise of a rap manosphere counterculture
entry.summary: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: an unbothered, radically different, equal but opposite response to rap's podcast bros.

entry.title: Suicide is up among Black Americans. We need to talk about it.
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin hosted a panel conversation about mental health and suicide in the Black community, exploring a difficult subject in deeply personal conversations.

entry.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln is returning home to San Diego
entry.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is returning home to San Diego Thursday after supporting the Iran war during a record long deployment of 265 uninterrupted days at sea that included reports of deteriorating conditions among its crew.

entry.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
entry.summary: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.

entry.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
entry.summary: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

entry.title: South Korea to recall its ambassador to Ukraine over North Korean POW dispute
entry.summary: The South Korean announcement on Thursday came days after its President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified punitive steps if Ukraine refuses to apologize over the revelation.

entry.title: South Korea test-flies its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon
entry.summary: The test follows North Korea's recent hypersonic missile test. Tensions between the Koreas have increased after land mine explosions injured three South Korean soldiers near the border. North Korea denies responsibility.

entry.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine's public buses leave 30 dead as blackouts worsen in Kyiv
entry.summary: Russia and Ukraine are locked in a long-range aerial war while their armies remain largely deadlocked on the front line, more than 4 1/2 years since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

entry.title: ICE has quietly used this warehouse as a detention facility all summer, neighbors say
entry.summary: Throughout the summer, rumors have been bubbling in North New Jersey that ICE has quietly been using a warehouse as a detention center. NPR investigated.
